name: food-app
behavior: Onboarding shows once, then sign in, then the tabs. Signing out returns to sign in. The session is saved on the device (AsyncStorage) and guarded with Expo Router’s Stack.Protected.
Menu (rolling donut shelf), Offers (coupons that unlock with the bag total), Bag (checkout) and Profile. The kit’s BottomNav is the tab bar, with the bag count as a badge.
Donuts added on the Menu land in the bag; a coupon picked on Offers is applied at checkout. Pay is a stand-in — wire it to your payment sheet.
Pushed from Profile. Appearance (System / Light / Dark) re-themes every kit component instantly.
Auth handlers in app/sign-in.tsx and payment in app/(tabs)/bag.tsx are stand-ins that wait and succeed. Menu, coupons and the user live in lib/food-app/data.tsx.
